snippet.title: Pizza Kidd - Official Gameplay Trailer | The MIX Fall Game Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Pizza Kidd is a high-impact 2D beat ’em up set in a gritty sci-fi fantasy world. Battle grotesque monsters, unearth ancient secrets, and unleash martial arts fury in a pixel-art brawler inspired by 90's anime, noir comics, and arcade legends like Street Fighter II, Streets of Rage, and Ninja Warriors. Watch the Pizza Kidd trailer to see gameplay and more on what you can expect. Pizza Kidd will be available on PC. A Kickstarter campaign for Pizza Kidd is coming soon.
